answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. A echo of per-task receipts records who did what, and the pearl of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, forfeited on duplicate submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the nebula of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
